instruction: Candid group photograph, medium shot. On an outdoor rooftop under an overcast sky, a group of six friends stands in a tight line. From left to right: the man in the gray hoodie (R2) stands neutrally; the woman in the white jacket (R5) stands beside him; the man in the dark blue jacket (R6) smiles with his arm around her shoulder; the woman in the plaid shirt (R3) smiles gently; the man in the green jacket (R4) stands with his arm around her; and the woman in the light gray sweatshirt (R1) stands on the far right. They all look towards the camera. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene with a cool color palette.
